title.zh: 互動式段落播放器 · Theme A

desc.zh: IraStoria 原創曲 Theme A 的段落切片：播放中點選段落，會在目前段落結束時無縫接續（含 pick-up／tail 重疊）；沒選的話「隨機」鈕自動接手；I 段可自我循環。接續白名單待定。
desc.en: Section slices of the original IraStoria track Theme A: pick a section while playing and it joins seamlessly when the current one ends (pick-up/tail overlap); otherwise Random takes over; section I loops itself. Transition whitelist pending.

concept_level_note: ADR-004 self-check 2026-08-29: generic queued-section playback with random fallback, written from scratch. Audio = the user's own original track Theme A (user decision 2026-08-29 to publish real mp3 slices); no project code or gameplay details.
dependencies: none (Web Audio API only); audio/*.mp3 (~11 MB)
